description: S459 round 3 MED-2 + LOW-MED-3 (legitimate writes that round 2 refused): `@rows.length = 2` on an `L[]` and `@ls.length = 0` on a `number(>0)[]` shorten the arrays — a length is not an element, so the element judge does not run on it. A row removed in place (`const r = @rows[0]; @rows.shift()`) has left the cell, so a later write to it (`r.n = -5`) is not judged against the cell's type.
rationale: §53.3.3: the assignment is applied if and only if the predicate evaluates to true — shortening writes no value into any element, and a value no longer held by the cell is not assigned into it.
